title: monorhythm
description: `monorhythm` is a multi-interval, multi-output rhythm generator designed to produce simple rhythms from a pattern list, where 0 is a rest, 1 a normal beat, and 2 an accent. It accepts a measure interval in milliseconds and outputs beat, accent, and sync bangs; in `exclusive` mode beat and accent bangs are mutually exclusive, while `nonexclusive` makes an accent supplement the beat bang.
